# sicif

> Compute the sine and cosine integrals in single-precision floating-point format.

<section class="intro">

The sine integral is defined as

<!-- <equation class="equation" label="eq:sine_integral" align="center" raw="\int_0^x \frac{\sin t}{t}\; dt" alt="Sine integral."> -->

```math
\int_0^x \frac{\sin t}{t}\; dt
```

<!-- </equation> -->

and the cosine integral is defined as

<!-- <equation class="equation" label="eq:cosine_integral" align="center" raw="\gamma + \log( x ) + \int_0^x \frac{\cos t - 1}{t}\; dt" alt="Cosine integral."> -->

```math
\gamma + \log( x ) + \int_0^x \frac{\cos t - 1}{t}\; dt
```

<!-- </equation> -->

where `γ` is the [Euler-Mascheroni][eulergamma] constant.

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var sicif = require( '@stdlib/math/base/special/sicif' );
```

#### sicif( x )

Computes the sine and cosine integrals in single-precision floating-point format.

```javascript
var v = sicif( 3.0 );
// returns [ ~1.849, ~0.12 ]

v = sicif( 0.0 );
// returns [ 0.0, -Infinity ]

v = sicif( -9.0 );
// returns [ ~-1.665, ~0.055 ]

v = sicif( NaN );
// returns [ NaN, NaN ]
```

#### sicif.assign( x, out, stride, offset )

Computes the sine and cosine integrals in single-precision floating-point format and assigns results to a provided output array.

```javascript
var Float32Array = require( '@stdlib/array/float32' );

var out = new Float32Array( 2 );

var v = sicif.assign( 3.0, out, 1, 0 );
// returns <Float32Array>[ ~1.849, ~0.12 ]

var bool = ( v === out );
// returns true
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var randu = require( '@stdlib/random/base/randu' );
var sicif = require( '@stdlib/math/base/special/sicif' );

var x;
var y;
var i;

for ( i = 0; i < 100; i++ ) {
    x = randu() * 100.0;
    y = sicif( x );
    console.log( 'si(%d) = %d, ci(%d) = %d', x, y[ 0 ], x, y[ 1 ] );
}
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
